ui.tagline: Umufasha wawe wo ku murima, arakora ata kuri internet inyuma y'aho akoresheje Internet ubwa mbere.
ui.home.offlinePrep: Gucungura amakuru kugira akoreshwe kure y'ubuhinga bwa none... ugume ukoresha internet gushika ivyo birangiye
ui.scan.live.dark: Ni mwijima cane, murondere umuco mwinshi
ui.ask.advEnglish: Impanuro ku bijanye n'ibiterwa zirerekanwa mu congereza gisubirwamwo kuri urwo rurimi (beta).
ui.ask.scanHint: Mumbwire ivyimburwa n'ikibazo, canke nimusuzume ku rupapuro.
ui.ask.title: Nubaze Agri Lab.
ui.ask.sub: Nubaze ibijanye n'indwara z'ibiterwa, ibiciro, imvura n'ubutaka
ui.ask.hello: Mwaramutse! Ndashobora kwishura ibibazo vyerekeye indwara z'ibiterwa, ibiciro vy'ibimera, imvura n'ubutaka. Ni igiki woshima kumenya?
ui.ask.q.disease: Ni gute nkora ku ndwara y'igituntu c'ipome?
ui.ask.q.price: Umwembe uzogura angahe mu kwezi kuza?
ui.ask.q.rotation: Ni igiki nkwiye kubiba inyuma y'ibigori?
ui.ask.outOfScope: Ndazi gusa ivyerekeye indwara z'ibiterwa, ibiciro vy'ibimera, imvura n'ubutaka muri Agri Lab, ni co gituma ntashobora kubishura.
ui.ask.notFound: Nta makuru y'ivyo mfise mu makuru yanje.
ui.ask.noPlace: Ndagusavye ubanze uhitemwo aho uba kugira ngo nshobore kwishura ku bijanye n'aho uba.
ui.ask.askRain: Kugira ngo ivyo bishoboke, mbwira kuri tab Rain nimba hari imvura yaguye uno musi.
ui.ask.help: Nshobora kuvuga amazina y'indwara z'ibiterwa nkoresheje ifoto (Scan), nkakubwira ivyo ukwiye kuzirwanya, nkagereranya ibiciro vy'ivyamwa, nkerekana amahirwe y'imvura, nkaguha impanuro ku bijanye n'ubutaka, umwimbu be n'ivyo utegerezwa kubiba (Igihugu).
ui.ask.disclaimer: Inyishu ziva ku makuru n'ingingo ngenderwako vya porogaramu, atari kuri internet.
ui.audio.none: Nta jwi ry'urwo rurimi riri kuri telefone.
ui.lang.betaNote: Ururimi rwerekanwa ko ari rwa beta ni rwo rwihindurwa n'imashini kandi ruracageragezwa n'abavuga ururimi kavukire.
ui.scan.unsupported: Not in our data yet None None None
ui.scan.unsupportedOther: Ivyo bisa n'ibiterwa, ariko nta na kimwe muri vyo dusanga mu makuru yacu.
ui.scan.unsupportedMore: Nusabe umukozi wawe w'uburimyi agufashe muri iki kibazo.
ui.scan.notPlantPct: Not a plant None None None

ui.home.setPlace: Nushireho ivyogufasha kumenya amakuru y'aho iwanyu
ui.home.landSub: Ubutaka, umwimbu n'ibiterwa vyiza kuruta ibindi
ui.home.installSub: Nukoreshe nk'aho ari agakoresho asanzwe. Niwakugurura rimwe kuri internet, uzokoresha mu buryo bw'ubuhinga bwa none
ui.ob.4.d: Nuyifungure rimwe ukoresheje internet kugira ngo ishobore kubika ibintu vyose. Inyuma y'aho ikora ata internet. Amafoto yawe ntiyigera ava kuri telefone yawe.
ui.in.sub: Wongere uyishire kuri ecran yawe yo mu rugo. Uce uyugurura rimwe ukoresheje internet kugira ngo ukingire ibintu vyose; inyuma y'aho, izoba ikora itariko iraboneka.
ui.in.ios.chrome.1: Fyonda ku gakoryo "Gusangira" iruhande y'uruzitiro rw'amazina
ui.in.ios.other: Fungura uru rupapuro muri Safari, uce ugerageza kugabanya hanyuma uhitemwo Kwongerereza ku karangura k'urupapuro rw'umwirondoro.
ui.in.and.chrome.2: Hitamwo Gushiraho porogaramu (canke Kwongerereza kuri Home screen)
ui.in.desk.chromium.1: Click the install icon in the address bar.
ui.in.desk.safari.1: Mu giteramo c'ibisomwa, hitamwo File ▸ Add to Dock
ui.in.desk.firefox: Fungura uru rupapuro muri Chrome canke Edge kugira urushinze.
ui.in.other: Fungura imenyu y'igisuma hanyuma uhitemwo Install canke Add to Home screen.
ui.land.sub: Ico ubutaka bwawe butunze, ico wogura n'ico uzotera
ui.land.noData: Nta makuru y'ubutaka kuri iki kibanza (ubugaragwa, amazi canke amashamba menshi).
ui.land.approx: Regional estimate (525 km). A soil test is more accurate.
ui.land.last: What did you grow last season?
ui.land.lastNone: Nta kintu na kimwe / sinzi neza
ui.land.pickCrop: Tap a crop to see what fertiliser it needs
ui.land.why.legume_after: Imboga zo mu bwoko bw'ibiterwa vy'ibinyampeke zisubiza nitrojeni mu butaka.
ui.land.why.same_crop: Ico kintu nyene kirongera gutera ubumara n'indwara.
ui.land.why.same_family: Umuryango umwe w'ibiterwa usanga ufitaniye isano n'izindi nyamaswa be n'indwara.
ui.land.why.root_after_legume: Imizi irungukira ku bidukikije biva mu bwoko bw'amazutu.
ui.land.fertNone: Ubutaka bwanyu buramaze kuronka ivyo uwo murima ukeneye.
ui.land.fertNote: Niwemere n'umukozi wawe w'ugutandukana canke ikigeragezo c'ubutaka.
ui.land.source: Bivanye n'ibiharuro vy'ubutaka (iSDAsoil), ivy'imvura y'isi yose (WorldClim) be n'ivy'ubwoko bwa CHIRPS.
